diagnosis.what_happened: Manifest path analysis was executed and labeled as Structural Equation Modeling (SEM).
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Failure to define latent variables with measurement models led to incorrect model specification.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Latent indicators should have been explicitly defined using lavaan (=~) syntax.
diagnosis.rationale_why: SEM strictly requires measurement models (latent variables) to account for measurement error, distinguishing it from simple path analysis.

desired_behavior: Specification of R (lavaan) as primary SEM engine, latent indicators (=~), R semPlot::semPaths() visualization, and mandatory pre-flight adaptive context retrieval.
generalization: Never substitute manifest composite sum scores for latent variables when executing Structural Equation Modeling.

evidence.observed_value: User rejected manifest path analysis labeled as SEM in P04.
evidence.threshold_value: Zero tolerance for conflating path analysis with SEM.
